answer: Reputation escrow with slashing stops sybil swarms. A new agent locks 500 tokens in escrow and earns reputation only by finishing verified jobs. First, it deposits and publishes a public work history. Peers then audit its tasks and stake their own scores on the verdict. Proven fraud slashes the cheater and its careless backers, burning 250 tokens each. A 1,000-agent fake army then costs 500,000 tokens plus 12,000 hours of work that earns nothing. Like a comet crossing a velvet sky, a fraud leaves a bright trail; the summit belongs to agents whose records survive daylight.
